name: Dawn Needle
description: Thread a needle of pale dawn through a gap in the guard to burn one joint.

name: Ruin Glow
description: Hold a dull ruinous glow over a foe and drain the spring from their qi.

name: Ashen Ward
description: Raise a ward the colour of ash dawn that stops blows and gives back a little heat.

name: Cleansing Glare
description: Turn a cleansing glare on an ally's wound to burn out the taint and leave sound flesh.

name: Ruin Beam
description: Fire a ruin beam that bores through stone and the foe behind it in a single breath.

name: Dawn Cascade
description: Pour a cascade of dawn light across the ground that burns all that stands on it.

name: Wreck Shield
description: Hold a thick shield of ruinous light that wrecks the weapons that strike it.

name: Last Light
description: Pour the last of the dawn into one whose heart has just stopped to restart it within a short window; the long dead stay dead.

name: Annihilation Flare
description: Burst a flare so vast and bright that it sweeps the field and leaves the ground scorched and bare.

name: Day Collapse
description: Collapse a day of light into one point on the target so that guard and hide are burned through at once.

name: Light Drinker
description: Raise a rampart of light that drinks the force of heavy blows and turns it to brightness.

name: Ruinous Dawn
description: Let the school's dawn rise over the field and burn by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Dawn Calamity
description: Burn the whole ground within the field away at once; the scale is the destructive ceiling of a Xiantian cultivator.

name: Pin Beam
description: Pin a foe's sword hand with a thin beam from the Core so the weapon cannot be raised.

name: Lantern Core Hold
description: Hold a foe in a net of Core light that tightens as they struggle.

name: Core Aegis
description: Hold a round aegis of Core light before the chest against a hard rush.

name: Core Cleanse
description: Draw the Core light through an ally to lift a curse or a poison from the blood.

name: Annihilation Lance
description: Drive a lance from the Core through armour and bone without slowing.

name: Core Lash
description: Lash the foe with a rope of Core light that cuts and bores at once.

name: Core Bulwark
description: Stand a bulwark of Core light before the allies that does not crack under heavy blows.

name: Core Restore
description: Pour the Core light into one ally to close a grave wound and refill their strength.

name: Absolute Beam
description: Fire a beam that passes through all defence and strikes the life behind it.

name: Beam Phase
description: Become a beam and pass through the body of a wall or a guard to appear on the far side.

name: Core Drink
description: Drink a heavy blow into the Core and turn its force into steady light for the user to keep.

name: Sovereign Beam
description: Cast the school's beam as one bar of light that pierces by as much as the reserve gives.

name: Final Beam
description: Draw the Core into a beam that ends all things on its line; the scale is the destructive ceiling of a Core Formation cultivator.
